shorts.title: Craziest Historical Coincidences!
shorts.topic: Highlight 3 mind-blowing historical coincidences with impactful visuals. Each should be under 15 seconds. Use a countdown timer for each coincidence reveal.

shorts.title: Insane Animal Survival Tactics!
shorts.topic: Showcase three unique and bizarre animal survival tactics. Include footage of the animals in action. Overlay text explaining the tactic.
shorts.hook: You won't believe how this animal survives...

shorts.title: Mind-Bending Optical Illusions!
shorts.topic: Present a series of optical illusions (3-4) that mess with viewers' minds. Ask a question that prompts a response in the comments.

shorts.title: Strangest Laws Around the World!
shorts.topic: Present 3 unusual laws still in effect in different countries. Use visuals related to the countries/laws.
shorts.hook: Did you know it's illegal to...?

shorts.title: Foods You're Eating WRONG!
shorts.topic: Demonstrate the 'correct' way to eat common foods that most people eat inefficiently (e.g., cupcakes, oranges, etc.).
shorts.hook: You've been eating this wrong your whole life!

shorts.title: Little-Known Space Facts!
shorts.topic: Share 3 surprising facts about space and astronomy. Use visuals and animations to enhance the facts.
shorts.hook: Space is even weirder than you think...

shorts.title: Random Facts That Will Blow Your Mind!
shorts.topic: Present three completely random, surprising facts from various topics. Use visuals to illustrate each fact.
shorts.hook: Prepare to have your mind blown!

shorts.title: Crazy Sports Records!
shorts.topic: Showcase three unusual or little-known sports records. Focus on sports that are less mainstream, or obscure records from major sports.
shorts.hook: This sports record is absolutely ridiculous...

longform.title: The Untold Story of Area 51
longform.topic: A documentary-style exploration of the history, myths, and recent developments surrounding Area 51. Focus on declassified documents and expert interviews.
longform.outline: 1. Brief History & Location; 2. Conspiracy Theories & Alien Myths; 3. Declassified Documents Analysis; 4. Expert Interviews (historians, former employees if possible); 5. Current Status and Future Speculation
longform.inspired_by: Persistent public interest in Area 51 and UFOs

longform.title: The Science Behind Deja Vu
longform.topic: A scientific exploration of the phenomenon of déjà vu. Covering various theories, neurological research, and potential causes.
longform.outline: 1. Introduction to Déjà Vu and its prevalence; 2. Psychological Theories (memory, perception); 3. Neurological Explanations (brain function, seizures); 4. Research Studies and Findings; 5. Personal Experiences and Anecdotes; 6. Conclusion: What we know and don't know.
